entry.name: jit.gl.textmult
entry.description: The jit.gl.textmult object is very similar to jit.gl.multiple, but for text. It allows to treat a list of words as several jit.gl.text objects, which can be controlled through matrices.

arguments.name: drawto
arguments.digest: The named drawing context in which to draw (default = none). A named drawing context is a named instance of a,orobject. If no argument is provided the object will find a context implicitly.

arguments.name: inputs_number
arguments.digest: The number of inputs the object will have. The number of inputs determines the number of glparams that can be used.
